scripts.generate:tailwind:watch: chokidar './src/maps/**/*' './dist/tokens.json' './scripts/*' --initial -c 'bun run generate:tokens && bun run generate:tailwind'
scripts.components:sync-watch:plugin: chokidar './dist/**/*' './src/**/*' -c "if [ '{event}' = 'unlink' ] || [ '{event}' = 'unlinkDir' ]; then rm -rf '../unison-plugin/unison-components/{path}'; else rsync -aR '{path}' ../unison-plugin/unison-components/; fi"
scripts.components:sync-watch:playground-web: chokidar './dist/**/*' './src/**/*' -c "if [ '{event}' = 'unlink' ] || [ '{event}' = 'unlinkDir' ]; then rm -rf '../unison-playground-web/unison-components/{path}'; else rsync -aR '{path}' ../unison-playground-web/unison-components/; fi"
